networks.name: agentcheck
networks.description: AgentCheck checks open agentic websites against the Worldwide Agentic Web MVP spec and tells you exactly how to fix what fails.
sample_queries: My manifest fails CORS and I host on Netlify. What exactly do I add?
Is the partner network https://partner.example/tours safe to add to my allowed_peers?
Run my site's agent with one of its sample questions and tell me if it really answers.
Write the HOCON for my whole agent network for me.

peer_policy.note: AgentCheck's own MCP endpoint only. The site being checked is allowed for this page only, when the visitor runs a live test and approves the consent card.

agent_mcp.reason: The network is published as static files. AgentCheck's checking tools are a separate MCP server at https://agentcheck.netlify.app/mcp.
